name: Evolution — Live Topology
description: Fig 10.3 (evolution) as a GENUINE place-graph rewrite: a wildtype population establishes (organism nodes added), a fitter MUTANT arises, then a selection sweep adds mutant offspring and prunes wildtype until the mutant lineage takes over. Running it ADDS and REMOVES place-graph nodes at runtime — steppable topology for the loom run/animate feature.
